versions.name: S-F Scout Ranch

features.note: The 21-mile Three Notch Trail lies entirely within the property.
Thirty canoes available for unit use.
A climbing wall at Camp Gamble.
High and low challenge course, available year-round.
Leadership Hall seats 450 and has a commercial kitchen.
Camp Gamble runs as a patrol-method cooking camp.
Climbing and rappelling on natural cliffs, with cliff-top campsites.
The Eagle Range combines trap and skeet fields.
A stocked STEM pavilion with robotics, drones, and electronics kits.
Zip line at the Huck's Cove water park.

versions.summary: Sprawling 5,200-acre Greater St. Louis Area Council ranch on 270-acre Nims Lake near Farmington, Missouri, offering Scouts BSA resident camp in two styles—air-conditioned dining or patrol-method campsite cooking. Features aquatics, Huck's Cove water park, Eagle Range shooting sports, STEM, rock climbing/challenge course, and the APEX older-Scout track.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
